question: H.J. Res. 140
bill_title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN.
plain_language: This joint resolution opens approximately 225,504 acres of National Forest System lands in Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties in Minnesota to mineral and geothermal leasing. A Yea supports passing it in the Senate; a Nay opposes it.

question: Motion to Proceed to H. J. Res. 140
bill_title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN.
plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up H.J.Res. 140, which opens approximately 225,504 acres of National Forest System lands in Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties in Minnesota to mineral and geothermal leasing. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.

question: Motion to Table: Submitted Point of Order Re: H. J. Res. 140
bill_title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN.
plain_language: H.J.Res. 140 would nullify a Bureau of Land Management order that withdrew about 225,504 acres of National Forest System land in northeastern Minnesota from mineral and geothermal leasing. This vote was to table, or set aside, a point of order raised against the resolution. A Yea sets the point of order aside; a Nay keeps it pending.
